fix-001.title: Fix React Infinite Loop and API Response Issues
fix-001.implementation: Fix infinite re-render loops caused by non-memoized dependencies in useSetPageHeader hook across multiple pages, and fix API response structure in /api/teams route
fix-001.description: Resolve infinite React update loops and server errors by memoizing JSX elements, arrays, and callbacks passed to useSetPageHeader hook, and ensuring API routes return consistent object structures

rootCause.hookDependencies: useSetPageHeader hook has actions and breadcrumbs as useEffect dependencies, but pages pass non-memoized JSX elements and arrays that are recreated on every render
rootCause.renderLoop: Component renders → creates new JSX/array → useEffect detects change → calls setter → context updates → triggers re-render → loop repeats
rootCause.apiResponse: /api/teams route returns user: null and organization: null when lookups fail, but frontend expects these to always be objects

errors: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'call')

filesToModify.changes: Wrap actionButton in useMemo and click handler in useCallback
Wrap actionButton in useMemo, handler in useCallback, and breadcrumbs in useMemo
Wrap actionButtons in useMemo and breadcrumbs in useMemo
Fix response to always return valid objects with fallback values, include department field
Clear stale build artifacts causing 404 errors for layout.css

solutionPattern.imports: import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react'
solutionPattern.apiResponsePattern: user: isSuccess(userResult) && userResult.data ? { id: userResult.data.id, name: userResult.data.name, email: userResult.data.email } : { id: m.userId, name: null, email: '' }

acceptanceCriteria: npx tsc --noEmit passes without errors
pnpm build succeeds without warnings
/projects page loads without infinite loop errors

/departments page loads without infinite loop errors
/processes page loads without infinite loop errors
No 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors in console
API /teams route returns valid objects for user and organization (never null)
No 404 errors for layout.css
Page headers and action buttons render correctly
All page navigation and interactions work as expected
